Days.title: Days
Days.description: Number of days from the user's request. For example, pass 30 for 'no action in last 30 days'. Leave blank for 'no action recently' so the action defaults to 30 days.

AccountName.title: Account Name
AccountName.description: Optional account name filter if the user asks for Opportunities with no recent action for a specific account.

StageName.title: Stage Name
StageName.description: Optional Opportunity stage filter if the user asks for Opportunities with no recent action in a specific stage.

OwnerName.title: Owner Name
OwnerName.description: Optional Opportunity owner name filter if the user asks for Opportunities with no recent action owned by a specific person.
